content.text: {"id": "mm6448a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Logistic regression analysis was used to examine temporal trends from 2002–2014 survey cycles"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "reported prevalence of driving under the influence of alcohol alone among persons aged 16–20 years and 21–25 years declined from 16.2% to 6.6%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Percentage of persons who reported driving a vehicle under the influence of alcohol alone"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Total,12.4 (11.8–13.0)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, in 2014, the reported prevalence of driving under the influence of alcohol alone was greater than that of marijuana alone"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Reported prevalence of driving under the influence of marijuana alone did not change significantly during 2002–2014 in either age group"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "via household face-to-face interviews"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Logistic regression analysis was used to examine temporal trends from 2002–2014 survey cycles"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Logistic regression analysis was used to examine temporal trends from 2002–2014 survey cycles; p-values of <0.05 were considered statistically significant."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted to provide nationally representative estimates."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "restricted to respondents who reported past-year marijuana use and no other illicit drug use"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Low precision; no estimate reported."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
